verdict.rationale: Gaudi 3's own documentation covers running its Docker image and launching PyTorch training, DeepSpeed, distributed multi-node and vLLM/SGLang inference workloads. These are inherently scriptable, non-interactive execution paths that fit headless automation. The evidence consists only of doc section titles, and nothing shows CI-specific use such as pipeline runners, scheduler or orchestration integration, or unattended job examples. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs, headless job orchestration guidance (e.g. Kubernetes or schedulers), detailed rather than title-level documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of automated runs.
